name: Phonon-2.5 (and Phonon-2.5-English)

lineage.how_derived: low-bit (about 6-bit 'five-value' packing) compression of Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 into a 156 MB container; the card calls it quantized
lineage.family: Phonon (Fermion Research; not the Gradium Phonon TTS family)

purpose: Open speech recognition for 25 European languages in a 156 MB download that runs on Apple silicon and on Linux/Windows CPUs without a GPU (card).

license.name: Weights CC-BY-4.0, code Apache-2.0
license.notes: Repo carries LICENSE-WEIGHTS-CC-BY-4.0.txt (header 'Attribution 4.0 International' opened) and LICENSE-CODE-Apache-2.0.txt; card and config.json say cc-by-4.0. Full legal text not read; CC BY 4.0 allows commercial use and redistribution with attribution.

architecture.kind: FastConformer encoder + TDT transducer decoder (Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3) in a low-bit container, model_type parakeet_tdt_five_value

variants.notes: download 156.2 MB; unpacked 177.9 MB per config.json; needs the fermion-research runtime (MLX on Apple silicon, CPU engine on Linux/Windows)
English-only sibling, same size per card; not opened in detail

benchmarks.name: FLEURS test, average WER over 25 languages
benchmarks.harness: same harness and normalisation for all three models per card

benchmarks.name: FLEURS test, average WER over 25 languages
benchmarks.variant: parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3 (full precision, 2.5 GB), measured by the vendor

benchmarks.name: Open ASR Leaderboard, 7 English sets average WER

strengths: beats Parakeet v3 on 12 of 25 FLEURS languages (card table: e.g. Greek, Latvian, Slovenian), loses on major languages
weaknesses: German and French FLEURS WER worse than the uncompressed Parakeet v3 (6.67 vs 5.96 DE, 8.12 vs 6.61 FR, vendor table)
proprietary container needs the vendor runtime
soft.maturity: Phonon-2 (2026-09-28) had 388 likes on HF; Phonon-2.5 52 likes. Young vendor.

tona_fit.reason: Small and CPU friendly, but for German the uncompressed Parakeet v3 (see parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3) is better by about 0.7 WER points on FLEURS and fits every class anyway; the 156 MB size only matters on a phone or when RAM is the limit.
blockers: custom container format, no Tona audio module

sources.note: README with benchmark table, config.json, HF API
